notes.title: 🌊 ISLANDERS: New Shores Demo Is Here – Try the Next Chapter Today!
notes.content:
Hey ISLANDERS friends, we’ve got something special to share…

We’re incredibly excited (and honestly, a bit emotional!) to finally let you know that the next step in the ISLANDERS journey is here! 🏝️

[b]ISLANDERS: New Shores[/b] is part of [b]Steam’s City Builder & Colony Sim Fest[/b], and we’ve released a [b]DEMO [/b]that’s live for a limited time. This is your first chance to get hands-on with the game, and as long-time fans, we’d absolutely love for you to be among the first to try it out.

🌋We’ve taken everything that made the original ISLANDERS special and expanded on it - gently and carefully, like one of your best building placements. Whether you're a high-score chaser or someone who just loves zoning out and building something beautiful, there’s so much here for you to explore.


[h3]Just some of what’s new in ISLANDERS: New Shores:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Islands[/b] - Explore majestic new island types. Volcanic peaks in the “Lava” islands, or the tranquil beauty of the “Fantasy” islands. 
[*] [b]Photo Mode[/b] - Capture and share your stunning island creations with customisable filters and a turntable camera.
[*] [b]Expanded Soundtrack[/b] - Enjoy 75 minutes of original music that sets the perfect mood for your building adventures.
[*] [b]Dynamic Scoring Systems[/b] - Master innovative scoring methods - such as line of sight, distance bonuses, and inter-island strategies - to enhance your gameplay.
[*] [b]Boons[/b] - Unlock single-use power-ups that give you unique tactical advantages as you progress.
[*] [b]Twitch Integration[/b] - Streamers can now engage their audiences directly with interactive features built into the game.
[/list]
[h3]We Want Your Feedback![/h3]
As the OG fans of ISLANDERS, we would love to know your thoughts and feedback on how we can make ISLANDERS: New Shores even better. Let us know what you enjoyed & what could be improved from the demo, by filling out our short survey here:

[url=https://2ly.link/25obm]ISLANDERS: New Shores Demo Feedback[/url].

[h3]Watch the Devs Play the Demo Live![/h3]
Want to see the game in action first? Head over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2368930/ISLANDERS_New_Shores/]ISLANDERS: New Shores Steam page[/url] where we’ll be displaying the stream throughout the festival. Come watch the Devs play, share their tips and tricks to getting the highest score, and insight into how they made the game! 

Thanks again for being part of this community - we’re so excited to finally share ISLANDERS: New Shores with you. Let us know what you think, and happy building! 💙

From our Island to yours, we hope you enjoy the demo.
[i]The Station[/i]

notes.title: Islanders Valentine's Day Patch
notes.content:
[h1][b]Improvements[/b][/h1]

[b]Expanded Sandbox Mode[/b]

The sandbox mode received significant improvements with two features:

UX Improvements: 
[list]
[*] We placed the delete button out of the building zone in the UI.
[*] Also, users have a new shortcut to delete all the buildings on the island. 
[/list]
Island generation window: A new window to modify the parameters of island generation with variables like island types, biomes or weather.

[b]Island archive[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can save and load islands created with the sandbox mode.
[*] There are 20 save slots for islands.
[*] Every save is displayed with useful data so it's easier to recognize or remember each island.
[/list]
[b]Friends Score Tab[/b]
[list]
[*] We implemented a new filter in the leaderboard to display scores from players' friends.
[/list]
[b]Day/Night slider settings menu[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now use a slider in the settings menu to change the time of the day/night, pause it or play it
[/list]
[b]21st Island tip[/b]
Upon reaching the 21st island on Highscore Mode, a tip will inform the user that it won't be able to move to the next island as that one is the last one of them, however it can keep scoring points.

[b]Valentine's Day event [/b]
This event replaces the Christmas event. It includes themed buildings, music and VFX.

[h1][b]Bugfixing[/b][/h1]

[b]Fixed particles when placing buildings:[/b]
[list]
[*] Marjet
[*] Plateau
[*] Resort Oasis
[*] Temple
[*] Wall Plateau
[*] Water Plateau
[/list]

notes.title: Islanders Content Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Updates:[/h1]

• [b]Christmas pack is now available.[/b]
• [b]Christmas content will be exclusively available only for the duration 23rd December - 18th January[/b]
• In-game graphics and audio updated based on the current festivity.
• Users can keep the original content if they wish.
• Game menus have been unified between Console & Steam versions. 
• Real-time day/night cycles that modify the lighting and soundscape of all the islands have been added.
• The user can turn on/off this feature on the gameplay settings menu.
• We added new types of islands to all game modes that were previously console-exclusive.
• We added controller support to PC.
• Game mode selection added to the flow.

[h1]Quality of Life improvements:[/h1]

• Centre camera and centre pointer functionalities added
• Centre camera on keyboard using 'H' key
• Centre camera on controller pressing 'Left Stick'
• Centre pointer on controller only by pressing 'Right Stick'
• Cancel Pack selection: users can now cancel the Pack selection to allow them to check their island before deciding which pack they want to unlock

[h1]Bug fixing:[/h1]

• Fixed blocker if buttons were pressed multiple times
• Optimized menu save/load system
• Fixed that while using a gamepad, entering on "New Game" pop-up and exiting immediately, blocked the d-pad input until the user enter another menu
• Fixed Selection Pack Menu: Putting the cursor between text and image caused the button to scale up and down repeatedly

If you experience any bugs or wish to share you thoughts, join the Coatsink community on Discord: https://discord.gg/UFX5e7KPee

Have a wonderful holiday season!

notes.title: Sandbox, Mac & Linux
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34682547/e7216f5b479f861aac2d3bd50e8edfc695565b81.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hey everyone, we're super excited to introduce Sandbox Mode and bring ISLANDERS to MacOS and Linux![/h1]

With this update, we're bringing another bunch of exciting features to ISLANDERS and making it accesible to new players  out there. Here's what's new: 
[list]
[*] Sandbox Mode
[*] MacOS-Support
[*] Linux-Support
[*] Undo Feature
[*] Save/Load System Fix
[/list]
[h1]Sandbox Mode[/h1]
Introducing [b]Sandbox Mode[/b], a whole new game-mode for ISLANDERS.  For this new mode, we've made every building available and removed all placement restrictions so you can go nuts and build whatever you want. 

We've had tons of fun playtesting this feature and hope you will, too! If you want to make our day, share your creations in the community, we'd love to see what you come up with :)

You can access the sandbox mode by pressing the New Game button after finishing at least one highscore match.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34682547/2f13d37fde90e59377511e705287577253e19d1e.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34682547/3218da49a25dc4d91713610af62ea810c1147685.jpg[/img]

[h1]MacOS & Linux[/h1]
We're super happy so finally bring ISLANDERS to players on MacOS and Linux. All of this is a bit new to us, since we're not used to working on Mac or Linux so please let us know if anything doesn't work!

[h1]Undo Feature[/h1]
You've asked and we've listened: This update introduces the much requested undo button which you can use to undo your last building placement. Just click the undo-arrow that will appear in your building inventory after placing a building. Alternatively, you can just press the "Z" key. Undo becomes unavailable when you lose the game or open a new building pack. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34682547/39ab99e7fb2f5a1838780ae6a54fb3f274179d2e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Reworked Save/Load System[/h1]
We've taken some time to completely overhaul the system with which games are saved and loaded. We hope that this will permanently fix all "floating stuff" issues when loading the game. Pray with us and let us know if floating objects still occur. 

[h1]Endgame Rebalancing[/h1]
We rebalanced the score required for new buildings in the late game. Our goal with this is to prevent people from playing indefinitely and crashing the game because too many buildings have to be loaded/rendered at once. This change shouldn't have an effect on most players.

[h1]Future Planning[/h1]
We're slowly approaching the point where we feel like everything we wanted to see added to the game has been implemented. There's still [i]some[/i] things left but with this update we've crossed most of the big remaining ToDo's off our list. Now we're slowly getting ready to move on to new projects and challenges. This way, we get the chance to start something new, creative and exciting which keeps us motivated and you'll get new games from us. :)

[h1]Thank you for being super supportive and encouraging - we are incredibly grateful to have such a positive community. Have fun with the new features and let us know what you think![/h1]

Cheers,
Friedemann, Paul & Jonas
aka 
GrizzlyGames

[h1]Hey everybody, with this update we're adding Steam Cloud and fixing a bunch of small issues in ISLANDERS.[/h1]

[h1]Steam Cloud[/h1]
With this update, we’ve implemented [b]Steam Cloud Save[/b] in Islanders. From now on, your save games can be stored in the Steam Cloud and you’ll be able to access them from all your devices. If you don’t want that, you can opt out in the game’s properties in your library. This is our first time working with the Steam Cloud so please let us know if you experience any issues!

[h1]Other changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes led to[b] involuntary placement[/b] of a building right after selecting it. This was really annoying and we hope it’s gone for good!
[*] Fixed a small sound bug that caused the [b]Monument to emit Fountain noises[/b]
[*] Updated [b]French localization[/b] to remove some inaccuracies and mistakes
[*] Fixed visual bug that messed with the [b]lake's water edge[/b]
[/list]

We’re already working on the next exciting content update, so stay tuned! Thank you all so much for your support, have fun building cities!

Cheers, 
Friedemann, Paul & Jonas
aka GrizzlyGames

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34682547/8c962d7adf7963f428dc819e14d295cd4a686334.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34682547/fef9fd68ce0e1de456558850882e2ad13520cf02.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34682547/7c711e43f5774c4eb31b1105bd6db5c1355aa4fe.jpg[/img]

[h1]Buildings Added: Seaweed Pack[/h1]
The seaweed pack contains seaweed fields which need to be placed on water and the seaweed farms which needs to be placed on land.

With this addition we wanted to increase the variety in the early game. The range sphere of the seaweed farm has an offset to allow for some new and interesting placement strategies.

[h1]Building Added: Balloon[/h1]
The balloon is a flying building that gets points from the circus, towers and markets. This will give you a new option in the mid-game and it should be a nice addition to your beautiful city. 

[h1]Building Added: Monument[/h1]
The monument is a relatively small building that loves being next to parks and the temple but heavily dislikes fields and hop fields. Why? Cause the gods say so. This is supposed to be a new toy for our most skilled optimizers out there. Let’s see how many points you can squeeze out of this!

[h1]New Island Types[/h1]
As you might know islands in ISLANDERS are procedurally generated so “new island types” just means you’ll see even more variety from now on. Enjoy! :)

[h1]Screenshot Mode & Zoom[/h1]
With this update we’re adding two of the most requested features: Camera zoom and a screenshot mode that hides the ingame UI and cursor. You can enter the screenshot mode by clicking the camera icon in the bottom left corner of the main menu. We love seeing the amazing cities you build, so please keep sharing your screenshots and tag us with @_grizzlygames on Twitter if you post there! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34682547/b7b254139c8253788c6fe5586b857cc5f59ef7a2.png[/img]

[h1][b]Balancing Updates[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Reduced Wall-collider size to make them easier to place. Walls now have two range-spheres to allow for more visually pleasing placement.
[*] More water plateaus in late-game to decrease chances of running out of space.
[*] Slight rebalancing of Tower to allow for placement on higher ground (because it looks so cool).
[*] Slightly nerfed the “Air Temple” (Temple on Wall Plateaus over cities) by making it more centered in its range sphere but we also increased its range a bit for compensation.
[/list]
[h1][b]Other Small Changes[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Fishers, Warehouses, Plateaus, Breweries, City Centers and Shamans now get points from Seaweed Farms or Seaweed Fields and were rebalanced accordingly.
[*] Mills can now be placed on wooden platforms.
[*] Resort Oasis is a bit easier to place (reduced collider size and allows for more uneven ground).
[*] Jewelry earns 35 instead of 30 points from Gold Mine. 
[*] Other small adjustments to incorporate the new buildings.
[/list]
[h1][b]Quality of Life[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Your online highscore is now updated every time you enter the main menu.
[*] Added a safety prompt when clicking “New Game” to avoid losing progress on an active session.
[*] Base score-values for buildings (like the temple's infamous -75) show up in the tooltips now.
[*] Improved score-preview-UI readability. The little score numbers have an outline now. 
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34682547/c7b83a2a0c384f24ccdabffbd0a8d2eef259d983.jpg[/img]

We’re still humbled and excited to have such a positive and passionate community. Our approach has always been to be open and honest with you and therefore we want to give you a clear idea where we’re headed with ISLANDERS.

Our midterm goal is to move on to new exciting projects. We feel like that’s how everybody gets the best deal: We can keep doing what we love with new challenges and you’ll get new games! 

That being said, we’re listening to your feedback of course and still have a couple of cool things headed your way for ISLANDERS.

[h1]Thank you all so much for being such a supportive and positive crowd, keep it up! :)[/h1]

Cheers, 
Friedemann, Paul & Jonas
aka GrizzlyGames

[h1]Hey everybody, we've pushed a small update containing a fix for a rare savegame issue![/h1]

The issue would cause savegames from the 8th island to be corrupted, resulting in weird floating trees when those savefiles were loaded. Sorry to everyone who lost ingame progress due to this issue, we know how frustrating that can be. 

Thanks to everyone who reported the bug and helped us get it fixed! Please let us know if you encounter any other problems. We're reading everything you post in the discussions.

[b]Thank you all so much for being such a supportive and positve crowd, keep it up :)[/b]

Cheers, 
Friedemann, Jonas & Paul
aka GrizzlyGames

notes.title: Hello Everybody!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34682547/cbdc3567c42c1659f305e7709b584574bc993f7c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hey everyone, this is our first announcement after the game's launch![/h1]
[b]First of all: [/b]
Welcome to all the new players and thank you all so much for your support, for playing our game and for being an extremely positive & active community so far! 

Launching a game is stressfull and nerve-wrecking, but you have made this an awesome experience for us :) ISLANDERS gathered over 500 positive reviews within the first 5 days after launch, giving us the "Overwhelmingly Positive" tag.  We are proud, super happy and grateful for that. 

[b]What's next: [/b]
Currently, our highest priority is to make sure people who bought the game also get to play it. Luckily it seems like there aren't a ton of bugs and the ones that show up are pretty rare. There is however still a small number of people who can't play the game the way it's supposed to be played. We're doing our best to offer support to these players. If you're experiencing issues, please get in touch!

We're also reading all of your amazing suggestions and comments in the discussions and talking about what we'll be able to add to the game. We're a super small team (3 people) and pretty exhausted from the launch, but we'd love to add some features & content to the game in future updates! It's way too early to promise anything but we're looking into it :)

That's it for now, again, thank you for your amazing support and positivity, keep it up!

Cheers, 
Friedemann, Paul & Jonas
aka GrizzlyGames
